When agitated,
this POKéMON pro­
tects itself by spraying poisonous
sweat from its
pores.

When darkness
falls, the rings
on the body begin to glow, striking
fear in the hearts
of anyone nearby.

On the night of a
full moon, or when
it gets excited, the ring patterns
on its body glow
yellow.

UMBREON evolved as a result of exposure
to the moon’s waves.
It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move.
The rings on its body glow when it leaps
to attack.

Creado cuando la luz lunar alteró la estructura
genética de Eevee. Busca presas en la oscuridad.

The light of the moon changed Eevee’s genetic
structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.

Cuando lo baña la luz de la luna, los círculos de su
pelaje brillan levemente y se ve revestido de un poder
misterioso.

When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its
body glow faintly and it’s filled with a
mysterious power.

Umbreon evolucionó tras haber estado expuesto a ondas
lunares. Suele esconderse en la oscuridad en silencio y
esperar a que su presa se mueva. Cuando se lanza al ataque,
le brillan los anillos del cuerpo.

Umbreon evolved as a result of exposure to the moon’s waves.
It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a
move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

Cuando se enfurece, secreta un sudor venenoso
por los poros que lanza a los ojos de sus
enemigos.

When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores
secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at
its opponent’s eyes.

Su pelaje le permite camuflarse en la oscuridad,
donde espera con paciencia a que su presa se
distraiga para saltarle al cuello.

With its black fur, it blends into the darkness.
It bides its time, and when prey appears, this
Pokémon goes for its throat, and then eats it.

Un Pokémon de hábitos nocturnos. Sus grandes
pupilas le permiten distinguir con total claridad
a sus presas en la más densa oscuridad.

This Pokémon is nocturnal. Even in total
darkness, its large eyes can spot its
prey clearly!

Acecha a sus presas al amparo de la oscuridad.
Sus círculos emiten un brillo ominoso cuando se
dispone a saltar al ataque.

It lurks in the dark of night looking for prey.
At the moment it pounces, the rings on its
body glow dimly but ominously.

En las noches de luna llena, o cuando se exalta,
le empiezan a brillar los anillos de color dorado.

On the night of a full moon, or when it gets
excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.

It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight
bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and
perceive prey with absolute clarity.
